notes.title: Datswer 2.5.1
notes.content:
Datswer  2.5.1 

This list is all new features at this release

*Add new controls and rewriting engine from scratch
*Add Full control touch for mobiles and point and click for PC
*Add New controls by touch on character for jumping ,grab ledge, up , crawl and so on 
*Add New character animations like fast impact with walls and obstacles
*Add full touch inventory system with smooth scrolling
*Add four scene for choose level when you complete per level
*Add new graphics for cut scenes
*Add new camera change rooms
*Add check point (green crystal balls) for save point and game
*Add swimming in water that removed from previous versions
*Add turn character before move in water
*Add demo animations to mobile ports (previous versions was PC only)
*Add many new sounds FX to the game
*Add new GUI's and interface
*Add use easy choose item from inventory and automatically done it. 
*Add new shooting and do it automatic when you select the gun
*Remove virtual joystick for see better scene
*Change story and break it to four episodes
*Fixed control character issue in stick to obstacles
*Fixed character jumping (stick to cells sometimes)
*Fixed main character control crashes 
*Fixed crash when character was in water
*Fixed save game for PC version
*Fixed pass from obstacles after save game
*Fixed Battle with monsters as we had crash sometimes
*Fixed break stone and find secret way
*Fixed return to game after dead to last checkpoint
*Fixed crawl move and crash with inventory
*Improved performance and optimize mobile ports and get high fps
*Smoothing animations for hero and monsters and some objects
